snippet.title: Lumen's Call - A Yu-Gi-Oh! Roguelike
snippet.description:
Play free in your browser: https://hcdotpy.itch.io/lumens-call-demo
Full game (Windows / Mac, solo and online co-op): https://lumenscall.xyz
Discord: https://discord.gg/UcwQNBwkZv

Lumen's Call is a free Yu-Gi-Oh! roguelike deckbuilder. Pick a classic deck in its weak form and climb a tower of worlds. Every floor is a duel, an encounter or a mini game, and random rewards grow your deck along the way: new cards, relics that bend the rules, and upgrades that can make a card really broken. The Bosses cheat, and every run claims a universe on a shared map.

Duels run on the real ygopro-core engine (Master Rule 2, each side keeps its own Field Spell). Play solo, or with a friend in the full game.

The browser demo has three decks and the full Campaign. Nothing to install.

Lumen's Call is a free, non-commercial fan game. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Konami. Yu-Gi-Oh! and all card names and artwork belong to their owners.
